clue.text: Bad, heartless jokes circulated in office post

indicators.note: a word without its heart has lost its middle letter
things circulated are passed around and mixed up, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the word bad with its middle letter removed
taken as written

explanation.surface: Tasteless jokes are being passed round in an office posting.
explanation.definitionFit: A desk job is employment done sitting at a desk, that is, a post in an office.

clue.text: Calmed most of commotion during act

fuss, a commotion, without its last letter

explanation.definitionFit: To defuse a situation is to reduce its tension, so defused means calmed.

clue.text: Go back in lover's building and stay the night

to go is a euphemism for to urinate

explanation.surface: Someone returns to their partner's block of flats and stays overnight.
explanation.definitionFit: To sleep over is to spend the night at someone else's home.

blocks.note: a conjuror is a magician

explanation.walkthrough: "Champion's behind" means the champion's word comes behind the rest, so it goes at the end.

blocks.note: taken as written

clue.text: A letter from abroad

clue.text: Find characters in Essex tremendously radical

clue.text: Father's always less restrictive

first half of the word to

the letters of late rearranged

the word gent rearranged
first and last letters of his

clue.text: Reduces loading area in harbour
